title: Payroll
description: The branch's payrolls: what each employee is paid for a period, with advances and goods taken. Internal payroll: contributions and the legal payslip remain with the accountant.
chooseBranch: Choose a branch above to see and prepare its payrolls.
empty: No payrolls in this branch yet.
negativeNet: Owes more than their pay: nothing is paid; the rest stays on their account.

new.title: New payroll
new.hint: A draft is prepared with a payslip per active employee of the branch (of the chosen frequency): agreed pay, pending advances and goods taken. Then add overtime, bonuses or other deductions and set the goods discount before paying.

errors.period: Choose a valid period: "From" cannot be after "To".

run.title: Payroll {{number}}
run.draftHint: This is a draft: review each payslip, add what is needed and set the goods discount. Nothing moves until you pay it.
run.discardMessage: The draft is deleted; nothing had moved. You can prepare the period again.

pay.title: Pay the payroll
pay.hint: Paying does, in one step: salary and deductions on each employee's account, the goods settled (with the discount) and the net out of the chosen treasury account. It cannot be edited afterwards.
pay.confirmMessage_one: {{total}} is paid from {{account}} to {{count}} employee. Confirm?
pay.confirmMessage_other: {{total}} is paid from {{account}} to {{count}} employees. Confirm?

editor.goodsResult: {{discount}} is forgiven and {{deducted}} is deducted from the salary.

errors.line: Every line needs a concept and an amount above zero.
errors.percent: The discount is a percentage from 0 to 100.

print.title: Salary payment receipt
print.disclaimer: Internal receipt of what was paid. It does not replace the legal payslip.

errors.load: The payroll could not be loaded.
errors.save: It could not be saved. Try again.

codes.no-employees: No active employees in this branch with that pay frequency.
codes.payroll-not-draft: The payroll is already paid: it cannot change.
codes.account-not-found: That treasury account does not exist.
